1: God will sweep away idolaters and the complacent who say he does nothing. The great day of the Lord is near.
The medieval hymn Dies Irae draws on this chapter.
2: "Seek the Lord, all you humble of the land." Judgement on Philistia, Moab, Cush and Assyria.
3: Jerusalem's leaders are condemned, but a humble remnant will remain. "The Lord your God is in your midst; he will rejoice over you with singing."
